notes.content:

[*] [b]**Adjusted Tape 2 entities audio**[/b]
Changed the entities audio to be heard from a further distance.

Added a marker system to Tape 5. Players will now have red and green glowsticks to help them navigate the level. 

[*] [b]**New stamina bar**[/b]
Added a stamina bar and removed the breathing from playing as soon as you start sprinting. The breathing audio will now only play when you are below 50% stamina.
[/olist]

notes.title: Hot Fix #1
notes.content:
[olist]
[*] [b]**Reduced Tape 1 difficulty**[/b]
Changed the entities' 'transform' time from 6 seconds to 9 seconds, allowing players more time to create distance between themselves and the entity to break line of sight.

[*] [b]**Fixed bug with Tape 4 entity**[/b]
Fixed an issue where the entity in Tape 4 stays near you while you hide. This will help give players a safe window to come out of hiding.

[*] [b]**CORRUPTED Tape Fixed**[/b]
Fixed an issue where the CORRUPTED Tape would not count as completed after finishing the tape.

[*] [b]**Added Discord Rich Presence**[/b]
This will allow Discord to display what game you are playing under your activity, as well as show what level you are on.
[/olist]

Thank you to everyone who has played so far!

If you have any feedback, have any questions and/or would like to join our community, feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/aNsvtFqvSb]Discord Server[/url]

notes.title: Tape 2 Patch
notes.content:
I have noticed that Tape 2 has been unforgiving in ways that were not intended. Because of this, I have fixed the following:

[olist]
[*] [b]**The entity will continuously make noise while it’s behind you**[/b]
Before, the entity would make noise periodically as soon as it spawns behind you. Now the entity will make continuous noise while behind you so that there is no confusion on if the entity is still there or not.

[*] [b]**Reduced player's sight angle**[/b]
This should allow for players to have a slight view of the entity before it attacks. Before, even having the entity slightly on screen would end with a game over. This patch allows a bit more of a forgiving sight radius so that you can notice the entity in the corner of your eye and look away.

[*] [b]**Longer time before the entity attacks if it's not able to spawn**[/b]
Having the entity attack if your back was against a wall was added to prevent people from completing the level by running with their back against the walls. After noticing how this was affecting players, I have increased the amount of time you can have your back against a wall when it tries to spawn.
[/olist]

Thank you to everyone who has tried out the Demo so far!
